blocks.title: Time complexity
blocks.text: Time complexity naapti hai ke input ka size barhne par algorithm ka chalne ka waqt kaise barhta hai.
Chand adad ko tarteeb dena jaldi hota hai, magar adad barhne par waqt bhi barhta hai; time complexity se andaza hota hai ke list barhne par waqt kaise barhega.

blocks.prompt: Time complexity ki behtareen tashreeh kya hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: (b) algorithm ke mukammal hone ka waqt input size ke function ke taur par.

items: Time complexity: input size ke saath chalne ka waqt kaise barhta hai.
